commit_message:
[Merged] [turbofan] Reduce the amount of map loads during elements kind transitions

Adopt the "TransitionElementsKindOrCheckMap" concept from Maglev. It
allows us to do only one map load instead of one map load per transition.

fix_commit_message:
[turbofan] Fix TransitionElementsKindOrCheckMap

Take into account that TransitionElementsKindOrCheckMap might change the
map of an aliasing object.

h/t dmercadier@ for figuring out the fix.

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 8b490a9690b8 on top of intro b8d3f7d0cf64 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The new `kTransitionElementsKindOrCheckMap` case in `InferMapsUnsafe` only considers the trivial aliasing case (`IsSame`). It neglects the possibility of non-trivial aliasing (same heap object reachable via different SSA value paths). Other opcodes in the same function that can have side effects on aliasing objects correctly set `result = kUnreliableMaps` before breaking; the new case was missing this defensive assignment.
